mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing a calm, clear night in Verona with a current temperature of 72 degrees. Conditions are pleasant over Reddan Soccer Park under a waxing crescent moon, with no visible international space station passes expected tonight.

The City of Verona is highlighting options for sustainable waste management. Apartment residents who want to participate in composting can use private collection services or drop off their organic food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue.

Mark your calendars for upcoming local entertainment. Live music begins this Friday, July 17th, at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Additionally, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returns on Wednesday, July 22nd, at Hometown Junction Park.

According to the weekly police report, a vehicle-versus-bicycle collision occurred on Friday, July 10th, at the intersection of Old PB and Whalen Road. A 24-year-old cyclist sustained minor injuries, and the driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.
To round out your day, the Verona Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM. Today's featured flavor is Snickers Swirl, and tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Cookie.
